annotations.text:
Start here.

Main is the ledger — 14 findings, rechecked against the 1 Sep dump. 2 closed, 11 unchanged, 1 new.

Blast radius is the answer to "what does the fix touch" — measured, not estimated.

The three screen boards show the worst of it drawn.

The order matters.

39 confirm dialogs cannot be written at the screen layer — a consequence lives in the write set, the state cascade and the event fan-out.

Run the audit first and the copy falls out of it. Run the fix first and you get one string, 39 times.

Applied to the repo on 1 Sep:

177 orphan Cancel buttons deleted — none of those screens had a single input field.

38 confirm dialogs written per operation from the lineage, state models and events.

Payment `unknown` transcribed onto POS-005, WEB-012, KSK-008.

And both generators fixed, so it cannot recur.

Two of my own calls changed once the lower layers were read:

F-07 was CHEAPER — states/payment.yaml already modelled pendingConfirmation. No contract change; it was a transcription.

F-10 was WRONG — do not flip offlineCapable on P05. 15 of its 23 operations are offline:false. It needs a degraded mode, and that is a product call, so it is left open.
